description: This file defines a PHP class `RedirectResponse` that extends the `Response` class, used to produce HTTP redirect responses with a Location header.

classes.name: RedirectResponse
classes.description: A class producing HTTP redirect responses with configurable URI, status, and headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a redirect response with specified URI, status code, and headers. Validates the URI type and sets the Location header.
